parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL218 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
